Vulnerabilities.Title: OpenSSL 1.1.1 vulnerability allows remote code execution
Vulnerabilities.Description: A critical vulnerability in OpenSSL 1.1.1 before 1.1.2 allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via crafted TLS packets. This affects systems using SSL/TLS encryption for HTTPS connections.

Vulnerabilities.Title: SSL/TLS certificate verification bypass
Vulnerabilities.Description: OpenSSL 1.1.1f and earlier allows certificate verification bypass in certain configurations. An attacker could exploit this to perform man-in-the-middle attacks.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Buffer overflow in glibc string functions
Vulnerabilities.Description: A buffer overflow vulnerability in glibc string handling functions could allow local attackers to execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.

Vulnerabilities.Title: HTTP request smuggling vulnerability in requests library
Vulnerabilities.Description: The requests library versions before 2.28.1 are vulnerable to HTTP request smuggling attacks when used with certain proxy configurations. This could allow attackers to inject malicious requests.

Vulnerabilities.Title: Jinja2 Server-Side Template Injection vulnerability
Vulnerabilities.Description: Jinja2 versions before 3.0.1 are vulnerable to server-side template injection attacks through unsafe variable usage in templates. This could allow remote code execution.
